notes.title: Orca Insurgency Release Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148209/2554c3b3db5d0b4c12d4816cc233feec4f68877a.png[/img]

[h1]🐋[b] Orca Insurgency – Release Roadmap[/b][/h1]
[h2]🛠 Beta Phase (In Progress)[/h2]
📅 February – August 2025

[u]Deep Waters of Development
[/u]
What’s happening:

[h2]Core Features added-[/h2]
[list]
[*] Basic Trick System
[*] Rudder Biting
[*] Orca Rescue System
[*] Gamepad and Keyboard Controls
[*] Pod Formation Control (control how the pod follows you)
[*] Basic Gun Store (arm your Orca!)
[*] Campaign Mode and Survival Mode.  
[/list]

Final gameplay systems locked in

Full visual and audio experience added

Performance tuning across all platforms

Game balance updates based on internal testing

Steam SDK Integration

📢 Some community feedback is being gathered from early playtests.



[h2]🚧 Early Access Builds[/h2]
📅 August – October 2025

[u]The Early Access release.[/u]

What’s happening:

Final bug fixes and polish

Game balancing updates from testing and player feedback

Last tweaks to gameplay flow and difficulty

💡 Players in our closed test group are helping shape the final build with hands-on feedback.



[h2]🚀 Full Launch[/h2]
📅 Target: November 2025

[u]The full version of Orca Insurgency release.[/u] 

What to expect:

Full story mode + Survival mode unlocked

All core systems and content available

Community feedback channels open

Ongoing patches for early post-launch issues



[h2]🌊 Post-Launch Support[/h2]
📅 Ongoing from November 2025

The journey doesn't end at launch. We'll be expanding, refining, and evolving the game with your help.

Planned updates include:

Regular balance and bug fix patches

New enemies and mini-missions

Community-requested features and quality-of-life improvements

Take we learn and start on Orca Insurgency 2! 

💬 We’re listening—your feedback helps shape the future of the game.

notes.title: Orca Insurgency Alpha Approaching
notes.content:
Hey Orca Insurgents, 
yuccabuccA here, just wanted to let everyone know I'm working diligently this month to get a playable version of the game out. 

Thanks for everyone's patience and understanding. Doing the indie dev thing with a full time day job can stretch development times out in unexpected ways. 
I hit 1 year of development on Orca Insurgency in November and feel its getting time to get it out to a larger audience. 

As for development updates- 

- Making 2 game modes - Campaign and "Protect the Pod" mode.

---- In Campaign mode, you rage across Europe's Atlantic coastline taking out everything from party boats and billion's yachts to disrupting supply chains and shutting down deep sea mining operations.  

---- In "Protect The Pod" mode, you survive as long as you can while saving other orcas and taking out as many enemy waves as you can. Working on different variations of this theme and hope to implement a leader board for high scores.  

-Created a a whole range of different yachts and boats including, cruise ships, large shipping boats and barges = ✓

-Added lots of sea life that you can interact with = ✓

-Made a ton of enemies boats, ships, sharks, and submarines =  ✓

-Added Salmon Hat easter egg = ✓

Reach out if you have suggestions or want to get involved. 
Stay posted for more updates coming soon. 
Check out my youtube for other dev videos, I'll try to post new ones when I can. 
https://www.youtube.com/@cartercantcode4853
